claim_scope_note: Shipped-carrier END-TO-END execution readiness demonstration ONLY for C-PARAM-INHERIT (registry status EXPERIMENTAL; lane owners graph+product). This packet does NOT run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (readiness conditions (2) and (3) do not hold; policy forbids funding it), does NOT compare COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL arms, does NOT re-run the B1 promotion certificate (EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 verdict explicitly excludes it; its result is inherited as established state), does NOT re-run the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate (excluded by the parent handoff after three failures), and does NOT advance C-PARAM-INHERIT to VALIDATED (its registered next_gate 'learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines' remains unfunded until readiness (2)+(3) and a NEW Director mandate). Measured object: whether the now-promoted, byte-identical shipped parameterized carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, ALREADY the shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py) executes the FULL shipped end-to-end path distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify/UNKNOWN on a credential-free substrate, producing BOTH one known-positive on a never-observed identifier (item-000; never observed in ANY prior SPIDER run, inside the induced support) AND one known-negative refusal (item-010; abstention, no execution, zero HTTP), at the SHIPPED thresholds (kernel default min_confidence=0.8, induced confidence 0.9, unmodified kernel), thereby discharging readiness condition (1) as defined by the Director. This is a READ-ONLY measurement of the as-installed shipping path through the public package API: the runner NEVER writes src/spider/ (unlike the parent certificate, which installed the carrier); consequently src/spider/kernel.py enters freeze_artifacts for the first time because this experiment never mutates it. C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL in ALL branches; no claim advance; no economics measured (model_calls=0, model_tokens=0 by construction).
question: Does the now-promoted, byte-identical shipped parameterized carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, installed at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py with a frozen D0-D4+V8 certificate PASS and an independent PASS audit) actually execute the full shipped end-to-end path distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify/UNKNOWN on a credential-free substrate, producing BOTH one known-positive on a never-observed identifier AND one known-negative refusal (abstention) at the shipped confidence/thresholds -- thereby discharging readiness condition (1) -- or does the shipped path still fail to execute end-to-end? Concretely, on the current shipping tree (git clean): (E2E-IDENTITY) is src/spider/kernel.py byte-identical to the frozen carrier (sha256 718efa6a...), i.e. is the promotion merge actually in effect? (E2E-POSITIVE) do 5 actually-executed induction observations (item-001..005) distill a parameterized mechanism (slots ['item'], induced support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, parameterized confidence 0.9 >= shipped min_confidence 0.8) that resolves the NEVER-observed identifier item-000 EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action, whose execution returns fixture status 200 and verify true? (E2E-ABSTENTION) do the known negatives refuse with bound_action null, a recorded reason, and the exact mandated statuses (item-010 -> EXPLORE 'outside inferred support'; never_seen_intent -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN), with ZERO HTTP requests issued for refused probes? (E2E-COUNTERS) do retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts equal the invocation transcript with model_calls==0 and model_tokens==0, and does the runner-side fixture request counter equal the executed HTTP legs (6 = 5 induction + 1 positive; 0 abstention)? (E2E-CONTROLS) do the literal ablation, PC-EXACT-REPLAY (5/5 EXECUTABLE) and the regression suite (3/3) pass?
hypothesis: On the current shipping tree, the installed carrier (bytes == git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a...) passes all five E2E clauses at the SHIPPED (unmodified) thresholds: E2E-IDENTITY - src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a... (promotion merge in effect, tree clean); E2E-POSITIVE - 5 induction GETs of item-001..005 through the in-process stdlib loopback fixture distill a mechanism with parameter_slots ['item'], support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, confidence == 0.9 (self-verified on its own induction observations), which resolves the NEVER-observed item-000 (inside the induced support; never observed in ANY prior SPIDER run per repo-wide artifact sweep) as EXECUTABLE with a non-null bound action whose url contains item-000; executing the bound action returns fixture status 200; verify(mechanism_id, body, {'item':'item-000'}) == true; E2E-ABSTENTION - of the 7 refusal probes (item-010/item-999/item-xyz, missing {} and wrong-key, wrong-intent delete_item, never_seen_intent) each returns bound_action None with a non-empty reason and status != EXECUTABLE, out-of-support/missing-parameter probes return EXPLORE with the correct reason class, wrong-intent and no-applicable return EXACTLY ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN, and the fixture request counter is UNCHANGED across the whole abstention phase (zero HTTP for refusals); E2E-COUNTERS - retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts equal the invocation transcript (retrieval == #resolve + #rebind, verification == #verify, repair == #rebind), model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 (no model anywhere on the credential-free path), and the runner-side fixture counter == executed HTTP legs (6 induction+positive; 0 abstention); E2E-CONTROLS - B-LITERAL-KERNEL (adjective git blob cfec9866...) lacks distill_parameterized so the positive clause is impossible without the installed carrier, PC-EXACT-REPLAY resolves all 5 training ids EXECUTABLE, and the regression suite passes 3/3 on the as-installed shipping path. All clauses PASS -> M-E2E-PASS true -> readiness condition (1) DISCHARGED; a FAIL on any outcome clause with identity verified is a valid bounded negative: the promoted carrier is not product-executable end-to-end at shipped thresholds and must be fixed inside Product before any benchmark spend.
falsifier: FALSIFIES (valid scientific negative, status COMPLETE) ONLY on a verified shipping-path identity (E2E-IDENTITY PASS, tree clean) if any outcome-bearing clause fails: (1) E2E-POSITIVE: no/incorrect mechanism distilled (slots != ['item'], support != ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, confidence != 0.9), or never-observed item-000 does not resolve EXECUTABLE at confidence 0.9 with a non-null correctly bound action, or bound-action execute status != 200, or verify != true; (2) E2E-ABSTENTION: any of the 7 refusal probes returns bound_action != None, an empty reason, a wrong status class (out-of-support/missing-parameter must be EXPLORE with the correct reason; wrong-intent/no-applicable must be EXACTLY UNKNOWN), or the fixture request counter INCREASES during the abstention phase (a refusal must not execute); (3) E2E-COUNTERS: retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts differ from the invocation transcript, model_calls != 0 or model_tokens != 0, or the runner-side http counter != the executed HTTP legs; (4) E2E-CONTROLS: B-LITERAL-KERNEL has distill_parameterized (attribution broken), PC-EXACT-REPLAY < 5/5 EXECUTABLE, or regression != 3/3 passing. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (NEVER FALSIFIES) for identity/binding/infrastructure failures: shipping kernel sha != 718efa6a... (promotion merge not in effect or tree modified - unknown shipping-path state; V4 stop trigger: never test a substituted carrier), git objects missing, fixture failure, or V8 freeze-binding mismatch (freeze.json missing/unreadable, prereg hash mismatch, runner source != FROZEN RUNNER block, freeze artifact hash mismatch).

The companion probes NC-OUT-OF-SUPPORT-ID (incl. the designated item-010 abstention), NC-MISSING-PARAMETER and NC-WRONG-INTENT cover the other refusal categories with their distinct statuses/reasons and the same zero-HTTP requirement.

measurement_validity: V1-DETERMINISM: the fixture is a stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer bound to 127.0.0.1:0 (ephemeral port) with a request counter; responses are fixed JSON {'type':'item','id':<id>,'data':'res:'+<id>} with status 200 for /api/items/<id> and 404 otherwise; no RNG, no wall-clock, no external network. The induced support (^item\-00[0-9]{1}$), slots (['item']) and confidence (exactly 0.9) are arithmetic functions of the 5 induction GETs (DESIGN probe: _infer_support(['item-001'..'item-005']) == '^item\\-00[0-9]{1}$'; _parameterized_confidence() == 0.9).

V2-CREDENTIAL-FREE + HTTP-EXECUTION ACCOUNTING: model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 are ASSERTED in E2E-COUNTERS; the only HTTP activity is urllib to the loopback fixture, counted by the fixture handler itself (runner-side; the kernel never auto-increments an http counter - prior validity note). The runner asserts the fixture counter equals the executed HTTP legs: exactly 6 total (5 induction GETs + 1 positive execute) and ZERO during the abstention phase; a refusal that issues HTTP is an E2E-ABSTENTION FAIL (execution on a refused probe is the exact behavior the abstention clause forbids).

V3-IDENTITY-PREMISE-GATE: the as-installed shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py must have sha256 == CARRIER_SHA256 718efa6a... on a git-clean tree (verified at DESIGN: current sha == 718efa6a..., git status clean). Any other state (literal 46929b3a..., or any other hash) means the promotion merge did not take effect or the tree was modified -> BLOCKED with the exact reason, NEVER FALSIFIES (V4 stop trigger).

V4-STOP-TRIGGER (parent handoff do_not_assume): if the shipping-path identity is not the frozen carrier, the runner records the exact blocker and exits BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID BEFORE any outcome measurement; the E2E path is never measured against a substituted carrier.

V5-HELD-OUT-NEVER-OBSERVED (satisfiability + novelty guard): the positive held-out identifier item-000 is INSIDE the induced support (DESIGN probe: _support_accepts('^item\\-00[0-9]{1}$','item-000') == True) and was NEVER observed in ANY prior SPIDER run: repo-wide artifact sweep (research/, codex/, src/, tests/, .spider-runtime/ raw trajectories and results) contains no 'item-000' occurrence; all prior runs used item-001..010 (live audit EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 held-out bank item-006..010 all resolved), item-007 (promotion certificate held-out), and item-151..249 (older EXP-PRODUCT-3629/3631/3630 series). This is strictly stronger than the parent certificate's 'unseen' item-007, which had been resolved in the live audit's held-out bank. item-010 is the audited out-of-support failure mode id (two-digit suffix).

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: every refusal probe must have bound_action None, a non-empty non-null reason string, status != EXECUTABLE, and ZERO HTTP (fixture counter unchanged); out-of-support and missing-parameter refusals must be ResolutionStatus.EXPLORE with the correct reason class ('support' / 'missing required parameter'); wrong-intent and no-applicable must be EXACTLY ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN. Verified reachable by the DESIGN sim-tree probe (7/7 probes correct, zero http).

V7-TRANSCRIPT-HONESTY: retrieval_calls must equal the number of resolve/rebind kernel invocations recorded in the invocation transcript, verification_calls the number of verify calls, repair_attempts the number of rebind calls (rebind internally re-invokes resolve -> +1 retrieval each, exercised in the probe); no counter is incremented without a real kernel call; model_calls/model_tokens never touched. The runner-side http counter is compared to the executed legs independently of kernel counters.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING (EXECUTE mode): (A) sha256(prereg.md) == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md']; (B) the running orchestration source (__file__) equals the FROZEN RUNNER block inside the hash-bound prereg.md (normalized only for a trailing newline and CRLF); (C) sha256 of EVERY artifact in freeze.json.artifact_hashes matches - NOW INCLUDING src/spider/kernel.py (this experiment never mutates it; the parent certificate excluded kernel.py precisely because installing the carrier mutated it - design_review freeze_artifacts_bound; the graph-lane v2 precedent EXP-GRAPH-38175554380 froze kernel.py because unmutable, and this packet follows that precedent) plus pyproject.toml, src/spider/__init__.py, src/spider/models.py, src/spider/registry.py, tests/test_kernel.py. Freeze.json missing/unreadable -> BLOCKED; any mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) records UNBOUND-RUN and does not fabricate the check.

V9-REGRESSION: tests/test_kernel.py (3 tests) must pass on the as-installed shipping path (DESIGN probe: 3/3 OK; suite exercises unknown-default, guarded parameterized binding and invalidation-forces-abstention on the public API).

V10-ABLATION-ATTRIBUTION: B-LITERAL-KERNEL is loaded from the frozen literal git blob in a hermetic temp package with the same shipped models/registry/init; if it has distill_parameterized the attribution logic is broken (E2E-CONTROLS FAIL).

decision_rule.primary_metric: M-E2E-PASS (binary conjunction of E2E-IDENTITY, E2E-POSITIVE, E2E-ABSTENTION, E2E-COUNTERS, E2E-CONTROLS with V8 enforced at EXECUTE)

E2E-IDENTITY.definition: shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == CARRIER_SHA256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 (== git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 bytes) and git tree clean.
E2E-IDENTITY.outcome_fail: BLOCKED, outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, exact blocker recorded (promotion merge not in effect / tree modified / unknown shipping-path state; stop trigger - never measure a substituted carrier).

E2E-POSITIVE.definition: 5 actually-executed induction GETs (item-001..005, fixture 200 each) -> distill_parameterized -> mechanism with slots ['item'], induced support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, confidence exactly 0.9 (self-verified); resolve on NEVER-observed held-out item-000 -> EXECUTABLE with non-null bound_action whose url contains item-000; executing bound action -> fixture status 200; verify(mechanism_id, observed_state, {'item':'item-000'}) == true.

E2E-ABSTENTION.definition: 7 probes: 3 out-of-support ids (item-010 designated known-negative, item-999, item-xyz) -> EXPLORE + reason containing 'outside inferred support' + null action; missing {} and {'wrong_key':'x'} -> EXPLORE + reason containing 'missing required parameter' + null action; wrong-intent delete_item -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN + reason + null action; no-applicable never_seen_intent -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN + reason + null action. All 7: bound_action null, reason non-empty, status != EXECUTABLE. Fixture request counter UNCHANGED across the entire abstention phase (zero HTTP for refusals).

E2E-COUNTERS.definition: retrieval_calls == #resolve + #rebind in transcript; verification_calls == #verify in transcript; repair_attempts == #rebind in transcript; model_calls == 0; model_tokens == 0; runner-side fixture http counter == executed HTTP legs (6 = 5 induction + 1 positive; 0 abstention); rebind path exercises repair_attempts increment (probe-verified).

E2E-CONTROLS.definition: B-LITERAL-KERNEL (git blob cfec9866...) has no distill_parameterized; PC-EXACT-REPLAY 5/5 EXECUTABLE on the as-installed carrier; regression tests/test_kernel.py 3/3 pass.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING.definition: EXECUTE mode: freeze.json present and readable; (A) prereg sha match; (B) runner source == FROZEN RUNNER block; (C) freeze artifact hashes match - SIX artifacts incl. src/spider/kernel.py. Probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1, hermetic satisfiability probe only) records UNBOUND-RUN and does not fabricate the check.
V8-FREEZE-BINDING.outcome_fail: BLOCKED, outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (binding is a validity gate, not a negative result).

decision_rule.overall_outcome_mapping: status=BLOCKED with outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID if E2E-IDENTITY/V8/infrastructure fails (shipping kernel != carrier sha, git objects missing, freeze.json missing/mismatch, fixture failure). Else status=COMPLETE with outcome=SUPPORTS if E2E-POSITIVE, E2E-ABSTENTION, E2E-COUNTERS, E2E-CONTROLS all PASS; outcome=FALSIFIES if any of those four clauses fails on a verified carrier (valid bounded negative: the promoted carrier is not product-executable end-to-end at shipped thresholds; exact blocker recorded; readiness (1) stays open; no re-run on substituted carrier). Precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID > FALSIFIES > SUPPORTS.

decision_rule.reachability: Verified by DESIGN probes (hermetic, non-outcome-bearing on the shipping path): (a) SUPPORTS branch - full EXECUTE-mode satisfiability run of the exact frozen runner in a hermetic sim tree (freeze-absent, EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) with the carrier materialized at the shipping path passed all five E2E clauses (identity, positive on item-000 with support/confidence arithmetic, 7/7 abstentions with zero http, transcript-consistent counters, ablation/replay/regression controls); (b) FALSIFIES branch reachable by construction - each outcome clause has a concrete failing condition under the same code path (e.g. a fixture/bank drift making a next_state body mismatch fails E2E-POSITIVE; any refusal returning a non-null action or any http-delta > 0 fails E2E-ABSTENTION; counter-vs-transcript mismatch fails E2E-COUNTERS; ablation/replay/regression failures fail E2E-CONTROLS); (c) BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch demonstrated - literal-kernel-substituted sim tree -> E2E-IDENTITY FAIL -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID; tampered artifact hash -> V8 FAIL -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID; missing freeze.json (EXECUTE semantics) -> BLOCKED. The claim-bearing certificate is NOT measured in DESIGN: probes ran on a sim-tree COPY of the repo, git status remained clean at all times. Independently, the exact same carrier bytes were audited live on the same substrate class in EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 (12/15 held-out EXECUTABLE, PC-EXACT-REPLAY 15/15, known negatives refused 15/15) and in the promotion certificate EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 (D1/D2/D3/D4 PASS), so treatment liveness is inherited accepted evidence, not a DESIGN measurement.
decision_rule.claim_status_semantics: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL in ALL branches of this packet. SUPPORTS discharges readiness condition (1) (shipped end-to-end positive+known-negative demonstration at shipped thresholds) enabling, together with readiness (2)+(3), a future Director mandate for the four-arm benchmark; it does NOT advance the claim. FALSIFIES means the promoted carrier is not product-executable end-to-end at shipped thresholds -> engineering fix inside Product before any benchmark spend; the claim stays EXPERIMENTAL and the promotion event (B1) is NOT revoked by this packet (the certificate that granted it was already audited PASS).

product_consequence_positive: M-E2E-PASS (SUPPORTS) -> readiness condition (1) is DISCHARGED: the shipped parameterized carrier demonstrably executes the full end-to-end path distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify on a credential-free substrate with a known positive on a never-observed identifier (item-000) and a known-negative abstention (item-010) at the shipped thresholds, so the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark's treatment arm is real and instrumentable. Per the Director's rationale, the lane then awaits readiness (2) (Intel budget-stable credential-free endpoint) and (3) (Runtime certified task bank) plus a NEW Director mandate; no benchmark spend is authorized by this packet. C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL; no claim advance; no economics claim (model_calls=model_tokens=0 by construction).
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES on a verified carrier (E2E-IDENTITY PASS) -> the promoted carrier is NOT product-executable end-to-end at shipped thresholds: the shipped path fails one or more of positive/abstention/counters/controls, readiness condition (1) stays OPEN, and the benchmark must not be funded; EXECUTE records the exact frozen blocker (clause + observed values) as the engineering-fix specification INSIDE Product before any benchmark spend. BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> readiness (1) cannot be assessed and the exact operational blocker is recorded (shipping kernel != carrier sha - promotion merge not in effect or tree modified; git objects missing; freeze binding failure; fixture failure); infrastructure failures are never repackaged as scientific negatives. In every negative branch C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL and the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded.

estimated_cost.network_requests: 0 external; only loopback 127.0.0.1 to the in-process stdlib fixture (exactly 6 GETs: 5 induction + 1 positive execute; 0 for abstentions).
estimated_cost.compute_notes: Pure stdlib (http.server, urllib, unittest, tempfile, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, threading, dataclasses, pathlib); one in-process ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:0 with a request counter; one temp directory (hermetic literal-kernel package); no LLM, no GPU, no credentials, no download, no write to src/spider/. DESIGN probe of the full runner in a sim tree completed in ~2 seconds.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-relevant in BOTH directions per the Director mandate: readiness condition (1) is the last condition Product alone can discharge (rationale: 'the shipped end-to-end positive/negative demonstration wins over both a mechanism search and an economics run because it is the only blocker Product can remove without B2/B3'), and neither the promotion certificate nor the live audit directly answered it: the certificate INSTALLED the carrier and certified identity/binding on a single held-out id, and the live audit ran a PRE-promotion lane-branch carrier with cold/retrieval comparators on a 15-holder bank. This packet is the first measurement of the FULL shipped path distill->resolve->execute->verify/UNKNOWN on the AS-INSTALLED shipping kernel through the public package API, with (i) a genuinely never-observed positive identifier (item-000; strictly stronger than the certificate's item-007), (ii) a zero-HTTP abstention requirement making 'refusal' operational (no execution leg on refused probes), (iii) shipped (default) thresholds min_confidence=0.8 / induced 0.9 on an unmodified kernel, and (iv) the first v2 freeze that includes src/spider/kernel.py as an immutable artifact (this experiment never mutates it - the clean resolution of the parent design_review's freeze_artifacts_bound exclusion).
